title: Candice:
headline: A volunteer who stands in the car line every month, in a part of Dallas with no grocery store, and goes home blessed by the faces she knows.
story: Candice has volunteered at the Dream Center for close to five years. On the 10 Oct Adopt-A-Block, Kalindi filmed her under the big tree by the church, in her yellow vest. Her story is a place, not an idea: she always serves in traffic, so she sees everybody come through the line and meets familiar faces each month. Then the fact that explains the line: there are no formal grocery stores in this area. Then her why: she goes away so blessed.
Series: Faces of the Dream Center. Hopeful, warm. One voice, hers. Kalindi's questions are cut out. The faith lines are hers and stay in her words.

Loops: L1 “Why does she stand in traffic?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:05 (she sees everybody come through the line). L2 “Why is there a line at all?” opens 0:00 and closes in the middle (no grocery stores for people), and the last loop, what she gets from it, closes in the button (“I just end up going away so blessed”). Stakes: an area with no grocery store; families still coming, still trying.
